company.summary: EQUINOR ASA is a public limited company (allmennaksjeselskap) registered under utvinning av råolje (NACE 06.100), based in Stavanger, founded 1972-09-18. Its verified website describes it as: “We are an international energy company headquartered in Norway, around 25,000 employees and with offices in more than 20 countries worldwide.” Public brand: Equinor. Registered activity: Selv, eller gjennom deltakelse i eller sammen med andre selskaper å utvikle, produsere og markedsføre ulike former for energi, avledede produkter og tjenester, samt annen virksomhet. Utleie av bygg og anlegg. Latest filed accounts (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, company accounts): revenue USD 68.0 bn, operating result USD 5.6 bn, net result USD 5.7 bn, total assets USD 103.4 bn, equity USD 39.2 bn. The period closed with a profit. Change from 2024 to 2025: revenue went from USD 72.5 bn to USD 68.0 bn (-6%); net result went from USD 8.1 bn to USD 5.7 bn (-30%); equity went from USD 41.1 bn to USD 39.2 bn (-5%). Financial position in 2025: operating margin 8.2%; equity ratio 37.9%. Calculated from the filed figures above. Registered employees: 21182. Leadership in the official register: Anders Opedal (managing director); Jarle Kjell Roth (chair of the board); Haakon Stephen Bruun-Hanssen (board member); Fernanda Lopes Larsen (board member); plus 10 further roles. 35 registered workplaces in Florø, Fornebu, Hammerfest, Harstad, Kjørsvikbugen, Kopervik and more. Official website https://www.equinor.com (identity check: legal name and registered phone); company-linked profiles on facebook, instagram, linkedin, x, youtube. Latest company-published activity: “Doubles North Sea gas discovery estimate” (2026-10-29). Most recent registry event: Registered employee count updated (2026-11-12). Not established from checked sources: active job ads (not available). Missing information is not treated as zero.
